GC_analysis.outside_observed_case_durations: Unknown; not event-timed. Cost remains in program wall.
GC_analysis.scope: GC events cover paired-case callback windows only; reporting, summaries, observer processing and gaps remain in program wall without event-timed durations.

independent_V2_comparison.CI_policy: Per-run query-batch intervals only; no pooled or between-session confidence interval.

128.interval_policy: Separate within-session intervals; no pooled or between-session confidence interval.

32.interval_policy: Separate within-session intervals; no pooled or between-session confidence interval.

512.interval_policy: Separate within-session intervals; no pooled or between-session confidence interval.

limitations: Separate within-session cluster-bootstrap intervals do not estimate between-session, hardware-population or training-seed variability.
Both V2 runs use one fixed checkpoint, schema, validation date, cohort, restricted feature policy and seed/order schedule; independent T4 reproduction does not establish generality.
All observations and tails remain in each summed estimator; no filtering, GC subtraction or pooled replacement percentage is produced.
Three observed full collections do not explain all size-512 long passes: several have only minor overlap and two have zero overlap. Their dominant cause is unresolved.
Lightweight GC/timer metadata overhead and natural collection cadence remain part of the versioned measurement. Removing one helper cycle does not eliminate full collection.
Raw sampled tensors are not exported; runtime assertions establish cross-mode identity and exported fingerprints independently match both source and first V2.
Hosted-snapshot historical semantics and the stronger activity baseline remain part of the scientific scope.
scope: Independent offline CPU audit of the second actual T4 natural-GC V2 run; no source modification, new GPU measurement, model evaluation, data download or raw-data rewrite.
